parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when paging is used. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated business policy.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The type of the associated policy. Valid values:
- **DomainBlacklist**: domain name blacklist.
- **DomainWhitelist**: domain name whitelist.
- **SoftwareBlock**: software blocking.
- **AppUninstall**: agent uninstallation.
- **DlpSend**: file outgoing.
- **PeripheralBlock**: peripheral control.

parameters.name: ProcessIds
parameters.description: The collection of approval process IDs.

parameters.name: ProcessName
parameters.description: The template name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: SaseUserId
parameters.description:
The ID of the associated approver. You can call the following operation to obtain the ID:
- [ListUsers](~~ListUsers~~): lists users.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username of the associated approver.
